comment: Pinned third-party runtimes for LoopForge Desktop. Fetch with: node scripts/fetch-vendors.js

git.name: Git for Windows MinGit (real GNU Bash)
git.why: Regular official MinGit includes GNU Bash as usr/bin/sh.exe. Copying that same real Bash binary to bash.exe enables its normal Bash mode (not BusyBox pretending to be Bash). Upstream cli_ondemand.go uses bash -c and pipes official scripts to bash; SOP nodes use sh -lc. CI proves BASH_VERSION, arrays and [[ ]] in a path containing spaces. BusyBox is no longer bundled.

loopforge.note: Always build all four Windows binaries from pristine pinned git archive plus verified desktop patch; never reuse dirty working-tree output or historical binary hashes. Build native-chat first with upstream npm lockfile. Emit resources/bin/build-manifest.json with source/patch/toolchain and per-binary SHA256; windows CI uploads it. Cross-platform byte-identical executable output is not promised.
